placers.name: Gavin Lovell
placers.note: Class of 2031: the only placer in the state younger than the class of 2030, 8th at 103 in the 2026 NYSPHSAA championship. New York lets a middle-schooler wrestle varsity under selective classification and the medal is real, but the platform mints a profile only for a current class year (2027-2030), so a class of 2031 has nowhere to sit yet. The placement is stored and linked; his profile follows when 2031 enters the window. Class year from the grade the tournament published (29 Oct 2026).

preFreshmanVerified.note: Joe Scott, Letchworth, class of 2028. Before his freshman year he placed 6 in 2024. New York allows it: the NYSPHSAA lets a middle-schooler wrestle varsity under selective classification, and the class year on each profile is derived from the grade the tournament itself published - the same field that flags the result as pre-freshman here. Camryn Howard, printed '8th' in 2024 and 'HS Sophomore' in 2026, is the worked example. Different from Maryland (COMAR 13A.06.03.02, grades 9-12 only) and Virginia (VHSL 28-2-1, eighth graders on junior varsity only), where the same shape proved a class year wrong (29 Oct 2026).
